spans.s: + पुर रुक्म- + पुर, n. the name of a fabulous town, Pañc. 84, 7.

रुक्म, i. e. रुच् + म,
 I. adj. Clear, bright.
 II. n. (ved. m.,

. Iron.
 III. m. A golden chain,

रुक्मिन्, i. e. रुक्म + इन्,
 I. m. The name of a prince, slain by बलराम.
 II. f. मिणी, A princess [] carried off and married by Kṛṣṇa, Mālav. d. 77; cf. Wilson, Hind.

and रूक्ष रू̆क्ष, adj.
 1. Rugged, rough, difficult, Vikr. d. 61 (र्ŭ).
 2. Harsh, unkind, Pañc. iv. d. 62 (रू˚); uncouth, Pañc. v. d. 6 (र्ŭ˚, but cf. Böhtl. Ind.

(र्ŭ).
 --Cf. A.S. rug, ruh, ruw; Engl. rough, rugged.
(? perhaps to be changed to रुक्ष).
† रूक्ष् रूक्ष्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from रूक्ष), Par. To be harsh.
